summary.text: C.T. Wilson is a Democratic member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 28 who is running for the Maryland State Senate in District 28 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An Army veteran and attorney, he has served in the House since January 2011 and is not seeking re-election to that seat in 2026.

paragraphs.text: C.T. Wilson was born in Missouri on February 20, 1971, and graduated from Freeburg High School in Freeburg, Illinois.
He earned a B.S. in psychology from Upper Iowa University and a J.D. from Howard University School of Law in 2003.
Wilson served in the U.S. Army from 1990 to 1997.
He worked as an assistant state's attorney in Prince George's County, where he was division chief of the Community Prosecution Unit, from 2005 to 2012, and he runs the Law Office of C.T. Wilson, LLC.
He is the author of 10,000 Hills: A Little Boy's Journey, published in 2014.
Wilson assumed office in the Maryland House of Delegates on January 12, 2011.
According to the General Assembly website, he serves on the Government, Labor, and Elections Committee and the Rules and Executive Nominations Committee.
Ballotpedia lists him as not running for re-election to the House in 2026, and he advanced from the Democratic primary for the Senate seat on June 23, 2026.
